text.en: 1. This Order is the Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for National Development) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 March 2024.

3. The Minister for National Development, with the Prime Minister’s approval, delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the First Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the First Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the First Schedule.

4. The Minister for National Development delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the Second Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the Second Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the Second Schedule.
